title: Credit Card Agent Registration: Start Free on GroMo in 2026
summary: Credit card agent registration on GroMo: sign up free with name and email, no documents, learn in the Academy, and earn up to Rs 2,400 per approved card.
body_markdown:
**Credit card agent registration** (new to the role? Read[what a credit card agent is](https://gromo.in/blog/what-is-a-credit-card-agent/) first) used to mean bank visits, paperwork, and waiting weeks for a DSA code. On GroMo, it takes minutes: install the app, sign up with your name and email, and you can start exploring credit cards from leading banks right away. No documents are needed to register, no exam, and no fee. You submit your PAN card just once, at the time of your first withdrawal.


This guide walks you through the full registration process step by step, what you get inside the app, who is eligible, and how much you can earn per card. Everything below is about becoming a credit card agent with GroMo, from install to your first payout.


## Credit Card Agent Registration at a Glance


**Registration cost** Rs 0, completely free


**Documents to register** None. Just your name, email, and mobile number


**Eligibility** 18 years or older, Indian resident


**PAN card** Needed only once, at your first withdrawal


**Cards available** 30+ credit cards from leading banks


**Coverage** PAN India, with pincode-wise availability shown in the app


**Payout per approved card** Up to Rs 2,400, most popular cards up to Rs 2,000


**Training** Free, inside the GroMo Academy feature


## How to Register as a Credit Card Agent on GroMo


1. **Install the GroMo app** from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
2. **Sign up with your name and email.** Verify your mobile number and your account is ready. No documents, no forms, no waiting.
3. **Start exploring products.** Open the credit cards section and browse 30+ cards across all major[types of credit cards](https://gromo.in/blog/types-of-credit-cards/) from leading banks, with the commission for each card shown upfront.
4. **Learn from the GroMo Academy.** Short free lessons teach you how each card works, who it suits, and how to talk to customers. Finish the credit card modules before your first pitch.
5. **Compare cards and check your pincode.** The app lets you compare credit cards side by side and shows which cards can be sold in your customer's pincode, so you never pitch a card that is not available in their area.
6. **[Share the card link and start earning](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-refer-and-earn/) .** Pick the right card for your customer, share its application link on WhatsApp, and help them complete the digital application. Track the status in your dashboard.
7. **Withdraw your earnings.** When your first commission is ready, submit your PAN card once and add your bank details. After that, withdrawals are simple transfers to your account.


## What You Get Inside the GroMo App


Feature What it does for you


GroMo Academy Free training on every product, in simple lessons, so you sell with confidence


Card compare tool Compare fees, benefits, and eligibility of credit cards side by side


Pincode availability See exactly which cards you can sell in your area or your customer's area, anywhere in India


Commission display The payout for every card is shown before you share it, no surprises


Application tracking Follow every customer's application from shared to approved in one dashboard


More products The same account lets you earn on savings accounts, loans, and demat accounts


## Eligibility and Documents: The Simplest in the Industry


This is where GroMo registration is different from a bank DSA process:


- **To register:** you only need to be 18 or older. Sign up with name, email, and mobile. No income proof, no education requirement, no experience needed.
- **To sell:** nothing more. Finish the free Academy lessons and start sharing card links the same day.
- **To withdraw:** submit your PAN card one time when you make your first withdrawal, along with your bank details. That is the only document in the entire journey.


## How Much Can You Earn Per Credit Card?


GroMo shows the live commission on every card. Current examples from the catalogue:


Card on GroMo Payout per approved card


AMEX Platinum Reserve Up to Rs 2,400


SBI Credit Card / SimplyCLICK SBI Up to Rs 2,000


HDFC Bank cards (incl. Pixel Play) Up to Rs 2,000


Axis Flipkart Credit Card Up to Rs 2,000


Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Card Up to Rs 2,000


AU Small Finance Bank / KIWI RuPay / Axis MyZone RuPay Up to Rs 1,750


Simple math: help 10 friends get the right card in a month at an average of Rs 1,500 and that is Rs 15,000, from your phone, with no investment. Commissions change with bank campaigns, so always check the live payout shown on each card in the app.


## Tips to Earn More as a Credit Card Agent


1. [Match the card to the person](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-sell-a-credit-card/) : online shoppers get cashback cards, travellers get travel cards, first-timers get lifetime free cards.
2. Always mention fees honestly. One surprised customer costs you ten referrals.
3. Use the pincode check before pitching, so every conversation is about a card they can actually get.
4. Stay with the customer during the application. Most drop-offs happen at document upload, and your help fixes that.
5. After every approval, ask one question: does anyone in your family or office need a card too?


## FAQ: Credit Card Agent Registration


**What documents are needed for credit card agent registration on GroMo?**


None at registration. You sign up with just your name, email, and mobile number. The only document in the whole journey is your PAN card, which you submit once at the time of your first withdrawal, along with your bank details for payouts.


**Is there any fee or exam to become a credit card agent on GroMo?**


No fee and no exam. Registration is completely free, and the GroMo Academy inside the app gives you free lessons on every card so you can learn before you sell. If any platform asks for a registration fee to make you an agent, treat it as a scam.


**How much does a GroMo credit card agent earn per card?**


Payouts go up to Rs 2,400 per approved card, with popular cards like SBI, HDFC, Tata Neu HDFC, and Axis Flipkart paying up to Rs 2,000. The exact commission for every card is shown in the app before you share it, and rates change with bank campaigns, so always check the live payout.


**Can I sell credit cards anywhere in India?**


Yes, GroMo works PAN India. The app also shows pincode-wise availability, so you can check exactly which cards can be sold in your area or your customer's area before you pitch. This saves you from recommending a card that is not offered in that location.


**How do I withdraw my credit card commission from GroMo?**


When your commission is ready, submit your PAN card once and add your bank account details in the app. After this one-time step, your earnings transfer to your bank account. You can track every application and payout in the dashboard.


**How fast can I start earning after registration?**


The same day. Registration takes minutes, the Academy's credit card lessons take an hour or two, and you can share your first card link immediately after. Your commission is credited after the bank approves your customer's application.


## Disclaimer


Nothing here is a guarantee of income. Credit card commissions on GroMo are set by the issuing banks, are maximums that vary by card and campaign, and are paid only on approved applications; check the live commission shown on each card in the GroMo app before relying on any figure. Card availability varies by pincode and bank campaign. Approval of any customer's application is decided entirely by the issuing bank. GroMo is a distribution platform, not a card issuer, and is available only to users aged 18 and above. This is general information, not financial advice; always describe card fees and terms accurately to customers.
